<!-- Generated by codeflower-app's cmd/gendocs: do not edit. -->

Check everything check --final checks, then assemble audit-SLUG/ in the output folder: README.md, audit.json, targets.tsv, report/index.html and report/report.pdf (the report printed), the pipeline (pipeline/ and pipeline.tar.gz), provenance/ (session.json with the review before sealing, and the chat's transcript, which the code flower worker supplies, redacted) and SEAL.json, the sha256 of every file. Run it in the sandbox the audit was made in. Sealing again replaces the folder; the new seal names the one it replaces.


## Usage

```sh
codeflower audit seal [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dir string` | `audit` | the audit folder (paper.yaml, targets.yaml, consistency.yaml) |
| `--no-roots` |  | seal without the plan kept in Roots |
| `--no-transcript` |  | seal without the chat's transcript (trusted less) |
| `--out string` |  | where to write audit-SLUG/ (default: the sandbox's one output folder, else here) |
